Preconditions: Faculty in Class Export tab

Feature: Registration verification email captured in stub mode
Preconditions: EMAIL_MODE=stub; clearStubEmails() run
Steps: POST /api/auth/register; inspect getStubEmails(); also test simulated mail outage on register
Expected Result: Captures 1 email to registrant containing /verify-email?token=... CTA link; registration still returns 201 if mailer fails
Notes: Verified in classdex-backend/test/scrum67-password-emails.test.js (task-1884) & password-email.spec.mjs (task-1892): stub captures verify email with /verify-email?token=, DB stores SHA-256 hash, registration returns 201 on mail outage

Feature: Resend verification cooldown & token replacement
Preconditions: Unverified user registered
Steps: Call POST /api/auth/resend-verification twice within 60s then after cooldown expires
Expected Result: Second request within 60s returns 429 with Retry-After; new token works and invalidates previous token
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js & password-email.spec.mjs: resend enforces 60s 429 Retry-After cooldown, shows disabled UI countdown, and invalidates previous token

Feature: Verification token boundary states (expired/used/sibling/tampered/unknown)
Preconditions: Valid verification tokens generated
Steps: Submit expired (>24h) token, already-used token, superseded sibling token, modified token, and nonexistent token
Expected Result: All fail with 400; valid unused token marks emailVerified=true once only
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js & password-email.spec.mjs: expired/used/superseded/tampered/unknown verification tokens fail 400 and render boundary UI; valid token verifies once cleanly

Feature: Forgot password anti-enumeration & stub email
Preconditions: One registered user + one unregistered email; EMAIL_MODE=stub
Steps: POST /api/auth/forgot-password for registered email then unregistered email with valid captcha
Expected Result: Both return identical 200 generic message; stub mailer captures /reset-password?token=... ONLY for registered email; SHA-256 hash stored
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js & password-email.spec.mjs: identical 200 & UI Check your email state for registered vs unregistered addresses; SHA-256 hashed token & stub /reset-password link generated ONLY for registered user

Feature: Forgot password rate limit (IP & normalized email)
Preconditions: Valid user + valid captcha verifier
Steps: Exceed 5 requests/15m by IP and by email casing variants
Expected Result: 6th request returns 429 rate-limit message
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js (task-1884): 6th request within 15m per IP and per normalized/cased email returns 429

Feature: Reset password flow & global session invalidation
Preconditions: User has active login session A and valid reset token
Steps: GET /api/auth/reset-password/validate then POST /api/auth/reset-password; check Session A and stub email
Expected Result: Validate confirms token; reset updates bcrypt password, burns token, revokes Session A (401), and captures 'password was changed' email
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js & password-email.spec.mjs: /reset-password validates token, updates password, burns tokens, revokes earlier session (401 + redirect to /login), and captures confirmation email

Feature: Reset token boundary & weak password rejection
Preconditions: Valid/expired/used/tampered/unknown tokens
Steps: Submit expired (>30m), reused, tampered, unknown reset tokens, plus weak password with valid token
Expected Result: All fail with 400 and leave user password unchanged
Notes: Verified in scrum67-password-emails.test.js & password-email.spec.mjs: missing/unknown/tampered/expired/reused/sibling tokens fail cleanly and weak/mismatched passwords do not burn valid token or change password

Feature: Change password validation/rate limit/session rotation
Preconditions: User logged into Session A (current device) and Session B (other device)
Steps: Test wrong current password 5x (429), password reuse (new===current), then valid change password
Expected Result: Wrong attempts rate-limited at 5/15m; valid change keeps Session A active, revokes Session B (401), and captures confirmation email
Notes: API subtest passed in scrum67-password-emails.test.js (task-1884), but E2E AccountSettings flow in password-email.spec.mjs (task-1892) failed 500 with Prisma P2028 Unable to start a transaction in the given time at index.js:1279 (DEF-10 Major)
